messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a weekday (or is observed on a weekday) and is surrounded by at least one weekend day, giving you a three‑day break.  

| Date Range | Holiday | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day | Sunday (observed on Monday, Jan 2) |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day | Monday (observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, Saskatchewan) |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Friday (observed in most provinces; some observe Easter Monday instead) |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Monday (observed in all provinces except Quebec) |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day | Saturday (observed on Monday, Jul 3) |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Monday (observed in all provinces) |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Monday (observed in all provinces) |
| **Nov 9–11** | Remembrance Day | Monday (observed in all provinces) |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Monday (observed in all provinces) |
| **Dec 26–28** | Boxing Day | Tuesday (observed in all provinces; gives a 3‑day break from Tue‑Thu) |

> **Provinces & Territories**  
> Some holidays are province‑specific (e.g., Family Day, Victoria Day, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). The table above lists the holidays that create long weekends across *most* of Canada. If you’re planning trips in a specific province, double‑check that province’s holiday schedule for any additional long weekends.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
